移動到大田Move to Daejeon

🏨 住宿：大田（Agoda）Stay: Daejeon (Agoda)

Agoda

🎨 Heredium 美術館｜塩田千春：在記憶之光中Heredium — Chiharu Shiota: Into the Light of Memory

  • 開放 11:00–19:00（最後入場 18:30），週三至週日開放，10/18 週日有開Open 11:00–19:00 (last entry 18:30), Wed–Sun — open on Sun 10/18
  • 門票：成人 15,000 韓元，為指定日期票；一張票可同時參觀 Heredium 與 Art Site SojaeTicket: adults 15,000 KRW, date-specific; one ticket covers both Heredium and Art Site Sojae
  • 包包、行李箱、雨傘不能帶入，需寄放置物櫃；館內沒有電梯No bags, luggage or umbrellas inside — use the lockers; no elevators
  • 出場後不能再入場；線上取消須在 24 小時前No re-entry; online cancellation up to 24 h before
  • 地址：大田廣域市東區大田路 735735 Daejeon-ro, Dong-gu, Daejeon

19週一Mon

首爾Seoul

🏨 入住：恩平佛光安諾剋日式旅館Check in: Anook Ryokan Hotel Eunpyeong Bulgwang

🛍️ 明洞：換錢 + 逛街Myeongdong: exchange + stroll

  • 換錢：Money Box 明洞本店，每天 9:00–21:00Exchange: Money Box Myeongdong Main Branch, daily 9:00–21:00
  • 交通：佛光站搭 3 號線到忠武路站，轉 4 號線到明洞站（我未查實際轉乘時間）Getting there: Line 3 from Bulgwang to Chungmuro, transfer to Line 4 for Myeongdong (transfer time not checked)
  • 小提醒：這天先從大田前往佛光住宿放行李，再去明洞換錢、逛街與霧眉；18:00 後再返回正式入住。提前寄放服務需先向飯店確認Plan: travel from Daejeon to the Bulgwang hotel to drop off luggage before visiting Myeongdong. Return for check-in after 18:00. Confirm early luggage storage with the hotel.

💄 15:00 明洞霧眉預約15:00 Eyebrow appointment, Myeongdong

  • 地址：서울 중구 퇴계로 14길 15 3층（首爾市中區退溪路14街 15 號 3 樓）Address: 15 Toegye-ro 14-gil, Jung-gu, Seoul, 3F
  • 建築入口在右側，進去後搭電梯到 3 樓Building entrance is on the right; take the elevator to 3F
  • 從明洞站 4 號出口出發（店家有提供路線照片）；迷路請聯絡店家From Myeongdong Stn Exit 4 (the shop sent route photos); contact them if lost

21週三Wed

景福宮韓服體驗 · 回台灣Hanbok day at Gyeongbokgung · Fly home

  • 12:00 前退房（可免費寄放行李）Check out by 12:00 (free luggage storage)
  • 👘 韓服：租借 + 拍照 + 午餐，整天待在景福宮一帶；穿韓服通常可免門票（以官方規定為準）👘 Hanbok: rental + photos + lunch, all around Gyeongbokgung; hanbok wearers usually get free entry (check official rules)
  • 🏯 景福宮：週三有開（週二休），約 9:00–18:00，最後入場為閉館前 1 小時；未穿韓服門票 3,000 韓元🏯 Gyeongbokgung: open Wed (closed Tue), about 9:00–18:00, last entry 1 h before closing; 3,000 KRW without hanbok
  • 🍴 用餐：景福宮周邊有通仁市場、西村、三清洞可選🍴 Food: Tongin Market, Seochon and Samcheong-dong are all nearby
  • 待補：韓服店名 / 預約時段 / 幾點離開景福宮 / 行李怎麼處理（寄飯店或寄韓服店）TBD: hanbok shop / booking slot / leave time / luggage plan (hotel or rental shop)
  • 交通：佛光站與景福宮站都在 3 號線（景福宮站 5 號出口）Getting there: Bulgwang and Gyeongbokgung stations are both on Line 3 (Exit 5)
  • 建議 20:00 前抵達仁川機場Arrive at Incheon by about 20:00
  • 23:00 起飛，10/22 00:35 抵達桃園Depart 23:00, land in Taoyuan 00:35 on 10/22
